diagnostic_sources.phases.py:
import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, statistics, subprocess, time

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = root.parent.parent
bench = repo.parent / 'algorithm-benchmarks/marimay'
compiler = repo / 'build/release/mmay'
archive = repo / 'build/release/native-runtime/release/libmmay_native_runtime_release.a'
counting = (bench / 'counting/counting.my').read_text()
names = {'frequency-map': ('intFrequencies', 5073),
         'unique-set': ('uniqueIntCount', 20001),
         'rune-frequency': ('runeFrequencies', 270012)}
flags = ['cc', '-std=c17', '-O2', '-g', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Wpedantic',
         '-Wconversion', '-Wshadow', '-Werror', '-fno-fast-math', '-frounding-math',
         '-ffp-contract=off', '-fexcess-precision=standard',
         '-I' + str(repo / 'bootstrap/include'), '-I' + str(repo / 'runtime/include')]
prefix = '''#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <time.h>
#include <stdint.h>
static uint64_t phase_bench_start, phase_count_start, phase_count_end, phases[3];
static uint64_t phase_clock(void) {
  struct timespec t; if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t) != 0) return 0;
  return (uint64_t)t.tv_sec * UINT64_C(1000000000) + (uint64_t)t.tv_nsec;
}
#define main phase_original_main
'''
suffix = '''
#undef main
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  uint64_t start = phase_clock(); int status = phase_original_main(argc, argv);
  uint64_t total = phase_clock() - start;
  fprintf(stderr, "{\\"prepare_ns\\":%llu,\\"count_ns\\":%llu,\\"checksum_ns\\":%llu,\\"entry_ns\\":%llu}\\n",
    (unsigned long long)phases[0], (unsigned long long)phases[1],
    (unsigned long long)phases[2], (unsigned long long)total);
  return status;
}
'''
manifest = {}
for name, (function, checksum) in names.items():
    path = root / (name + '.c')
    command = [str(compiler), 'build', str(bench / 'benchmarks' / name.replace('-', '_')),
               '--release', '--max-heap-bytes', '67108864', '--emit', 'c', '--output', str(path)]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True)
    source = path.read_text()
    matches = list(re.finditer(r'^static [^\n]*\b(mmay_g_f_[0-9a-f]+)\([^\n]*\) \{', source, re.M))
    functions = []
    for index, match in enumerate(matches):
        end = matches[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(matches) else source.index('static int mmay_g_public_message', match.start())
        functions.append((match, end, source[match.start():end]))
    begin = counting.index('public fn ' + function)
    operation = 'unique.add(value)' if name == 'unique-set' else 'counts.get(value)'
    span = counting.index(operation, begin)
    selected = [(m, end, body) for m, end, body in functions
                if '*mmay_g_start = ' + str(span) + ';' in body
                and ('mmay_g_collection_option(' in body or 'mmay_g_collection_update_result(' in body)]
    assert len(selected) == 1, (name, span, len(selected))
    count_symbol = selected[0][0].group(1)
    parents = [(m, end, body) for m, end, body in functions
               if '= ' + count_symbol + '(' in body]
    assert len(parents) == 1, (name, count_symbol, len(parents))
    edits = []
    for (m, end, body), entry, leave in [
        (selected[0], 'phase_count_start = phase_clock(); phases[0] = phase_count_start - phase_bench_start;',
         'phase_count_end = phase_clock(); phases[1] = phase_count_end - phase_count_start;'),
        (parents[0], 'phase_bench_start = phase_clock();',
         'phases[2] = phase_clock() - phase_count_end;')]:
        assert body.count('return mmay_g_s;') == 1
        body = body.replace('return mmay_g_s;', leave + ' return mmay_g_s;')
        offset = m.end() - m.start()
        body = body[:offset] + '\n' + entry + '\n' + body[offset:]
        edits.append((m.start(), end, body))
    for start, end, body in sorted(edits, reverse=True):
        source = source[:start] + body + source[end:]
    instrumented = root / (name + '-phases.c')
    instrumented.write_text(prefix + source + suffix)
    binary = root / (name + '-phases')
    compile_command = flags + [str(instrumented), str(archive), '-lm', '-o', str(binary)]
    subprocess.run(compile_command, check=True, capture_output=True)
    manifest[name] = {'count_symbol': count_symbol, 'benchmark_symbol': parents[0][0].group(1),
                      'counting_span': span, 'emit_command': command, 'compile_command': compile_command,
                      'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(root / 'phase-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
print('built three phase probes', flush=True)

limitations: Phases use four monotonic-clock calls at function boundaries in diagnostic generated C; all inputs, counting code, source checksums and shipped runtime remain unchanged.
The direct C runtime probe excludes input creation and managed-array/Option/Result transport; its timings are a diagnostic comparison, not a drop-in implementation of Marimay source semantics.
Isolated hashing time is not an additive component of the mixed loop because instruction overlap, branches and memory access differ.
Probe counters and allocation counts come from separate diagnostic runs whose times are not used; probe totals include final checksum reads and growth probes.
The sampled profile repeats 500 unmodified generated entries with independent complete setup/teardown, checking every output. Sampling counts are not exact CPU percentages.
Only three existing user workloads have phase and runtime timing here. Alternate table designs, string/reference keys and broad operation distributions still require comparative prototypes.
No end-to-end improvement, new table design, Go/Rust parity, CP42 completion or pushed CI closure is claimed.
